description: A painted scene of a stepped Mesoamerican pyramid with twin shrines on top. A warrior in a feathered headdress with a wooden sword leads a charge up the steps, beside a man in a jaguar-patterned suit. Defenders fight on the stairs and some climb them. On the lakeshore at left, crowds with baskets of produce and cloth stand near canoes on the water, with smoke and fire in the sky at top left. The painting runs edge to edge with no visible text, frame or border.
